## Summary

Describe the reusable system or defect addressed by this change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Playwright suites were run, or are not applicable

## Compatibility and quality

- [ ] Procedural behavior remains deterministic and seeded
- [ ] Save compatibility is preserved or a tested migration is included
- [ ] Performance budgets and graphics fallbacks are preserved
- [ ] Keyboard, scaling, motion, and other accessibility implications were reviewed
- [ ] Screenshots or browser artifacts are attached for visible changes
